name: cmdl32.exe
author: Elliot Killick

commands.description: Download a file from the web address specified in the configuration file. The downloaded file will be in %TMP% under the name VPNXXXX.tmp where "X" denotes a random number or letter.
commands.os: Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

detection: Reports of downloading from suspicious URLs in %TMP%\config.log
Useragent Microsoft(R) Connection Manager Vpn File Update
